notes.title: Our game’s demo will be live on October 1st.
notes.notes: [h3][b]The demo of Eliean Mor: The Lost Keepers will be available on October 1st. You can add it to your wishlist.[/b][/h3][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4014360/Eilean_Mor_The_Lost_Keepers_Demo/?curator_clanid=44711098"][/dynamiclink][/h3]

notes.title: OUR NEW GAME IS ''ELIEAN MOR: THE LOST KEEPERS''
notes.notes: [p]Our new game, Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers, which we've been working on for a long time, is now live on Steam.[/p][p]You can check out the trailer and other details on the store page, and if you'd like to be notified when the game launches, feel free to add it to your wishlist![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3871570/Eilean_Mor_The_Lost_Keepers/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
